The '''father''' of [[Varel DeVay]] hailed from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], where he enjoyed a life of privilege. His daughter, Varel, was a [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] who had studied at some of the best [[University/Legends|universities]] in the Core. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], she was trapped on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] and forced to work on biological weapons for him. After Varel's release when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] the planet, she contacted her father; he begged her to return home, but Varel refused as she was ashamed of what she had done. Instead, she signed on to the crew of the ''[[FarStar]]'', a New Republic [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]].
